about: The status page, /status/, and /status.json, as one Task Object of words (the StatusPage board, November 1, 2026). It lists every service and the public address each one is checked at. scripts/sync_status.py reads that list, makes one read-only GET of each address, with no credentials and one try, and writes the answers with their times to site/content/status.json. scripts/build_site.py renders the page and /status.json from that Task Object, so the two always agree. The recent problems are written here by a person on the ta-amps team.
title: Status | Agora
